BO-8										BODY — Front Door

13. INSTALL BELT MOULDING

(a) Install the belt moulding by tapping it with your hand.
(b) Install the two set screws.
(c) Install the weatherstrip on top near the glass on both sides of the door.

14. INSTALL REAR VIEW MIRROR

(a) Install the rear view mirror.
(b) Connect the wiring connector.
(c) Install the cover.

15. ADJUST FRONT DOOR GLASS

NOTE: Before adjusting the glass, check that the fitting of the door to the body is proper.
